description: Count tokens with a model's real tokenizer: o200k_base (GPT-4o and later), cl100k_base (GPT-4/3.5), p50k_base, r50k_base; qwen3 (Qwen3/Qwen2.5 family) and mistral-v3 (Mistral 7B v0.3 and similar), run locally. Claude's tokenizer is not public: claude-estimate is o200k × a measured factor, an estimate. Returns tokens, words, characters and % of the context window.
name: count_tokens
